excerpt.zh:
各位来客，我们在此向你问好。

我们早已知晓你们的存在，但由于担心自己会给你们的未来带来不恰当的影响，我们一直躲在幕后。不过，我们现在是时候从垂帘后走出来了，对于外行人而言，虚境的运作机制可能显得古怪且令人不安。正是处于这个原因，我们决定为你们提供指导。如果你们同意的话，我们愿意成为你们的引路人。

去探索吧，不过在我们下次重逢之前，记得注意安全。

texts.zh:
各位来客，我们在此向你问好。

我们早已知晓你们的存在，但由于担心自己会给你们的未来带来不恰当的影响，我们一直躲在幕后。不过，我们现在是时候从垂帘后走出来了，对于外行人而言，虚境的运作机制可能显得古怪且令人不安。正是处于这个原因，我们决定为你们提供指导。如果你们同意的话，我们愿意成为你们的引路人。

去探索吧，不过在我们下次重逢之前，记得注意安全。
texts.en:
Fellow travelers, we greet you.

Your presence on the galactic stage has long been known to us, but until now, afraid we might unduly influence your destiny, we have held back. However, the time has come to lift the veil; the ways of the Shroud may seem strange and unnerving to the uninitiated, and it is for this reason that we offer guidance. Realize that you have someone willing to be your teacher, if you so wish.

Wander safely, until our next encounter.

texts.zh:
很高兴与您相识！我谨代表[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]，欢迎您莅临鄙邦简陋的星际工坊。

诶呀…我在哪儿都能认出龙骨上的那些东西——制作的很精致。我们有着跟踪星系中飞船设计的习惯，试着同当地风潮保持一致。不过我刚刚讲到哪儿…？

啊，对了：欢迎您！请问我们要如何满足您打捞和回收的需求？
texts.en:
Pleased to make your acquaintance! On behalf of the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName], I welcome you to our humble, interstellar workshop.

Say... I'd recognize those keel fixtures anywhere - some fine work. We make a habit of keeping up with what's flying in the galaxy, try to keep up with local trends. But where was I..?

Ah yes: welcome! How can we facilitate your salvage and reclamation needs?

texts.zh:
您好，您好！我谨代表[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]，欢迎您莅临鄙邦的维修场。不论船体、引擎、蓝图还是配件：我们都有存货。

我可不是开玩笑——人们在老旧飞船里扔下的东西会让你大吃一惊的。最近我刚入[salvager_enclave_country.species.GetHandNamePlural]了一套完整的厨房单元，用黄金铸成的。爽到。

扯远了，请问我们要如何满足您打捞和回收的需求？
texts.en:
Hello, hello! On behalf of the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName], I welcome you to our salvage yard. Hulls, drives, blueprints, fittings: we stock it all.

I'm not even joking - you'd be amazed what people leave inside their old ships. Just recently I laid my [salvager_enclave_country.species.GetHandNamePlural] on an entire galley unit, cast in gold. Wild.

Anyway, how can we facilitate your salvage and reclamation needs?

texts.zh:
向您致以敬意！我谨代表[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]，欢迎您莅临鄙邦的工坊和废品场。大批专职工程师已经就绪，准备好维修、重建或是拆建几乎任何他们可以用工具鼓捣的东西。您会发觉我们对贸易的激情可谓永无止境。

请问今天我们要如何满足您打捞和回收的需求？
texts.en:
Salutations! On behalf of the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName], I welcome you to our workshop and scrapyard. Legions of dedicated engineers stand ready to repair, rebuild, and tear down just about anything they can latch a tool onto. You'll find our passion for the trade is quite insatiable.

How can we facilitate your salvage and reclamation needs today?

texts.zh: 很高兴又见面了，我们这里可是忙的很。贵国最近的各种事务处理的还好吗？我敢说我们现在还是一如既往的喧闹。空闲的[salvager_enclave_country.species.GetHandNamePlural]在处理过时的殖民船这方面可是很有一套的。
texts.en: Hello again! Busy times, these - I trust your empire's affairs are running smoothly? I dare say we're all abuzz here, as usual. Idle [salvager_enclave_country.species.GetHandNamePlural] make fast work of outdated colony ships...

texts.zh:
您好！我们今天又该怎样满足你们的工程需求呢？

呃，你们船身钢板上安装的玩意儿挺有意思，它们用起来效果如何？
texts.en:
Greetings! And how might we serve your engineering needs today?

Hmm, curious hull plate fixtures you have there - how are they working out for you?

texts.zh:
欢迎回来！嘿，来看看这些崭新丝滑的引擎怎么样吧！我真诚希望我们能对您维护舰船的方式做一些微小的贡献；它们会为此感谢您的。

那么我们如何为您效劳？
texts.en:
Welcome back! And hey, get a load of those smooth, new drive signatures! I do hope we're managing to impart some small, positive influence on the way you maintain your ships; they'll thank you for it.

How can we be of service?

texts.zh:
你好啊！别介意……只是在对这个工业级的全息发射器进行一些修修补补。这些，非常令人捉迷的装置。这可是我的拿手项目，研究这玩意究竟能够投影一个多大的全息图像。这甚至不及你将其投影到太空中的一半困难，看见没。

啊，我一开口能跑火车好几年呢。我该如何为你效劳？
texts.en:
Hello! Don't mind me... Just been tinkering with this here industrial holo-emitter. Fascinating devices, these. It's a pet project of mine, to see how large a hologram it could actually project. Not half as difficult when you're beaming one out into space, see.

Ah, but I could prattle on for ages. How can we be of service?

texts.zh:
欢迎！我很乐意同一些打捞业的同行会面——要知道，星系这个地方对我们来说老寂寞了呢。

你知道训练内容——我们将别人觉得没有任何用处的老旧部件收集到一起，然后赋予它们全新的生命。如果遇到任何用你的[Root.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]搞不定的事情，放轻松，我们会过来接手的。

那么，我们有什么能够为你的打捞和开荒事业提供便利的呢？
texts.en:
Welcome! I sure am glad to meet some fellow scavengers - the galaxy can be a lonely place for those like us.

You know the drill - we gather together old parts that no one sees any use for, and breathe new life into them. If there's anything you can't get your [Root.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] on, rest assured, we will have it.

Anyway, how can we facilitate your salvage and reclamation needs?

texts.zh: 向你问好！你是否对于运营一个帝国已经感到了厌烦？我可以加入我们的捡垃圾事业——完全没有那么多压力，你肯定可以玩得转的。
texts.en: Greetings! Have you gotten bored of running an empire yet? You could join us in the scrapping business - it's much less stressful, and you clearly have the knack for it.

texts.zh:
很高兴再次见到你！不要介意这些破铜烂铁，还有那些呻吟的声音。我们，呃……有朋自远方来！它们正在长身体；而且经常会有一点……饿肚子。很少有人知道，它们会以这样的速率重新长出那些鞭毛！

呃咳。打扰了。我该如何帮助你？
texts.en:
Great to see you again! Don't mind those scraping and moaning sounds. We have, uh... Guests, at the moment! They're a bit on the larger side; tend to get a bit... Hungry. And little wonder, at the rate they're regrowing those flagella!

Ahem. Excuse me. How can we help you?

texts.zh:
嗯嗯嗯，我们之前见过你们这群家伙……

我们跟你们没什么可说的，也没什么服务愿意提供的。麻利地滚一边去吧。
texts.en:
Hmm, we've met your ilk before...

We have nothing to say to you, nor any services to offer. Kindly be on your way.

label.zh: 我们遇到了一个自称是“面纱旅人”的人……
label.en: We met someone claiming to be a Veilfarer...

texts.zh:
太棒了！真的很高兴能能从您的手中接过这份差事。

根据我们的扫描仪，您有下列舰队处于可选范围之内。在附件中可以查看估价，现在请您做出选择吧。

我们可以将自己的舰船带到打捞者位于[salvager_enclave_system.GetName]星系的恒星基地，对自己的舰船进行估价和贱卖。
texts.en:
Splendid! It would be our pleasure to take that off your hands.

According to our scanners, you have the following fleets within range. You'll find our estimates attached; the choice is now yours!

We can have our ships appraised and scrapped if we bring them to the Salvagers' starbase in the [salvager_enclave_system.GetName] system.

texts.zh:
棒极了！那将是我们的荣幸……星辰在上，那是什么呀？！你居然称那是一艘舰船？我是说，我能够找到它是怎么……哇哦，它看上去可真是凶巴巴的。拜托了，千万不要冲动行事！我们能够从你那里接手活生生的“舰船”，但恐怕我们必须收取清洁费用。

根据我们的扫描，你的以下舰船位于范围之内。你能在附件里找到我们的预估；现在由你来做决定了！

我们可以将自己的舰船带到打捞者位于[salvager_enclave_system.GetName]星系的恒星基地，对自己的舰船进行估价和贱卖。
texts.en:
Splendid! It would be our pleasure to... By the stars, what is that?! You call that a vessel? I mean, I can see how it... Wow, it's a mean-looking thing. Please, don't do anything hasty! We can take living 'ships' off your hands too, but I'm afraid we must charge a clean-up penalty.

According to our scanners, you have the following fleets within range. You'll find our estimates attached; the choice is now yours!

We can have our ships appraised and scrapped if we bring them to the Salvagers' starbase in the [salvager_enclave_system.GetName] system.

texts.zh:
当然了！我们的服务一向直接明了：开一支舰队到[salvager_enclave_system.GetName]来，然后和我们打一声招呼。只要我们确认了您是舰队的主人，就能给出估价清单。随后我们就会接管舰队，您也能马上得到回收后的材料。

噢，不过切记：不要把别人的东西带过来拆解了！我们不想因此吃一遍苦头，可不能再翻车了……

我们可以将自己的舰船带到打捞者位于[salvager_enclave_system.GetName]星系的恒星基地，对自己的舰船进行估价和贱卖。
texts.en:
Of course! Our service is straightforward: bring a fleet in here to [salvager_enclave_system.GetName], and give us a hail. Once we verify ownership, we can provide you with a list of estimates. We'll then take possession, and your reclaimed materials will be with you in no time.

Oh, also: no scrapping of others' merchandise! We do not want to suffer through the kind of conflict that can bring up - not again, at least...

We can have our ships appraised and scrapped if we bring them to the Salvagers' starbase in the [salvager_enclave_system.GetName] system.

label.zh: 谢谢告知。我想问问其他服务……
label.en: Good to know. About your other services...

texts.zh: 谢谢！您应得的回收材料马上就到。
texts.en: Thank you! Your reclaimed materials will be with you shortly.

texts.zh:
太神奇了！舰船破破烂烂进来，完完整整出去。目前有以下几种类型可选。

要知道每艘我们翻新的舰船在出售后都享受钢铁三包。在船坞中翻新后，我们相信这些船只肯定开的比原装出厂时还舒服。

不过请记住：翻新相当耗时。在把一支舰队完整翻新之前，我们是没法卖船给您的。所以您也许需要日后再与我们联系。
texts.en:
Marvelous! When a busted-up ship comes our way, we work hard to restore it back to working life. Right now we have the following types available.

Know that every vessel we reclaim is sold under our Durasteel Guarantee. We're confident these ships will run more smoothly now than back when they were shipyard-fresh!

Just bear in mind: reclamation is a time-consuming process. We cannot provide you an entire squadron without having to restock afterwards, so you may need to check back with us in future.

texts.zh:
不论什么样的破船进到我们这来，我们都会尽全力使其焕发活力。不过现在我们的码头仓库里似乎空荡荡的。

请晚些时候再来，到时候再看看我们有什么能帮您的。每次翻新大概需要花上我们2年左右。
texts.en:
Well, whenever a busted-up ship comes our way, we work hard to restore it back to working life. Unfortunately it appears our docks are empty at the moment!

Please return later, and we'll see what we can do for you. It usually takes us around... 2 years for a complete set of refurbishments.

label.zh: 谢谢告知。我想问问其他服务……
label.en: Good to know. About your other services...

texts.zh: 十分感谢！
texts.en: Thank you kindly!

texts.zh:
当然了！只要您腾出给我们工作的地方，我方机械师就能随时关注当地的船只维修状况。

我们会准备好维修工坊模块所需的各种材料，让您可以将其安装到紧邻我方的恒星基地上。基地的模块槽位也许需要进行调整，不过一旦我方工程师成功建立工坊，你们就能将船只开进来维修。每隔一段时间，我们还能在贵国疆域内为您进行建造搭把手。

所以，听上去怎么样？这样的维修工坊还合您的意吗？
texts.en:
Certainly! You give us space to work, and our mechanics can fast-track your local ship repairs in no time.

We'll fix you up with all you need to attach a Salvage Works module onto the starbase adjoining ours. You may need to shift around a bulkhead or two, but once our engineers have a place to set up shop, your ships will be flying right through those repair bays! We can even help out with your construction efforts empire-wide, every once in a while.

So, how about it: does a Salvage Works take your fancy?

texts.zh:
当然！我们向最信任的客户们提供一个特殊的机会。简而言之：您给我们在[salvager_enclave_system.GetName]恒星基地工作的空间，我们的机械师就可以紧跟您当地的舰船维修工作。我们甚至可以为您恒星基地和船坞所进行的建设搭把手，全帝国范围内都行！

如果您感兴趣的话，我们很乐意进一步讨论这件事……等到我们的合作关系更加牢固之后。希望您能理解。
texts.en:
Certainly! We extend a special opportunity to our most trusted customers. In short: you give us space to work aboard a starbase here in [salvager_enclave_system.GetName], and our mechanics can fast-track your local ship repairs. We can even help out with your starbase and shipyard construction efforts, empire-wide!

If that's of interest to you, we'll be happy to discuss the matter further... once we feel more sure of this working relationship. We hope you understand.

label.zh: 谢谢告知。我想问问其他服务……
label.en: Good to know. About your other services...

texts.zh:
当然！我们的技术人员一直在努力工作，制定雄心勃勃的新工作计划，我们很荣幸能为您提供限时的生产力增幅。

我们将把您的维修工坊拨到高速档，替您所有恒星基地上的工程回收再利用零部件！我们甚至有一些锦囊妙计来帮助您生产舰船。这应该是有用的！大概~

请记住，此类工作是有代价的；我们无法经常提供帮助。
texts.en:
Of course! Our mechanics have been hard at work devising ambitious new work plans, and it would be our pleasure to extend to you a limited-time frenzy of productivity.

We'll put that Salvage Works of yours into high gear, reclaiming and repurposing parts for projects on all your starbases. We even have a few tricks up our sleeves to help you produce ships, in case that should be useful!

Bear in mind that work like this takes its toll; we shan't manage this often.

label.zh: 谢谢告知。我想问问其他服务……
label.en: Good to know. About your other services...

texts.zh:
再次向你致敬！我很高兴地宣布，我们已经准备好卯足力气将事业提升到一个新的高度，让打捞工作真正务有所值。

你有什么想法？准备好在你所有的恒星基地加快舰船建造了吗？
texts.en:
Hello again! I'm pleased to say we're ready to kick things back into a higher gear, and get that Salvage Works to really earn its keep.

What do you say? Ready to speed up shipbuilding across all your starbases?

texts.zh:
真是相当庄严的召唤啊。听到舰队在战斗中被击沉，我们的痛苦超乎您的想象，但太空中的生活是残酷的，有些事情不可避免。

……请原谅我的遐思。毫无疑问，那是我们能提供的服务。

如果您愿意授予我们打捞权并为我们提供残骸场的坐标，我们将会在合适的时候回报您。
texts.en:
A most solemn calling. It pains us more deeply than you can know to hear of ships stricken in battle, but life is harsh out here in the vacuum, and needs must.

... Please, forgive my reverie. Absolutely, that is a service we can provide.

If you would be so kind as to grants us salvage rights and furnish us with co-ordinates for these debris fields, we shall compensate you in due course.

texts.zh:
唉。所以，严酷的真空已经吞噬了更多船只……当然，我们很乐意从您所说的悲惨战场上回收一些积极的东西。

如果您愿意授予我们打捞权并为我们提供残骸场的坐标，我们将会在合适的时候回报您。
texts.en:
Alas. So, the harsh vacuum has claimed more ships... But of course, we will gladly attempt to reclaim something positive from this tragic battle you speak of.

If you would be so kind as to grants us salvage rights and furnish us with co-ordinates for these debris fields, we shall compensate you in due course.

texts.zh:
啊，是的，战斗：这是打捞的最悲哀的原因……您得原谅我，[root.GetRulerTitle]；野蛮的毁灭不会给我们带来欢乐。然而，我们明白这是不可避免的。如果你们的船不愿或不能筛查残骸，我们的确可以承接打捞工作。

有需要的时候请来找我们，并赋予我们打捞的权利。我们会用在那里发现的任何材料和知识来补偿您。
texts.en:
Ah yes, battle: that most sorrowful cause of salvage...

You'll have to forgive me, [root.GetRulerTitle]; barbaric destruction brings us no joy. However, we understand that needs must. We can indeed handle salvage under commission, if your ships are unwilling or unable to sift through the debris.

Come to us when need arises, and grant us the rights of salvage. We will then undertake to compensate you for whatever materials and knowledge we find out there.

texts.zh:
我为打捞工作最悲哀的原因而哀叹：战斗。请原谅我，[root.GetRulerTitle]，我们有理由对这样的破坏表示哀悼。不过，我们确实可以承接打捞工作。但这是我们向更为熟络的客户提供的服务。

有需要的时候请来找我们，我们将处理属于你们的残骸场。我们会用在那里发现的任何材料和工程知识来补偿您。
texts.en:
Alas for that most sorrowful cause of salvage: battle.

You'll have to forgive me, [root.GetRulerTitle]; we have our reasons for mourning such willful destruction. However, for our regular customers we can indeed handle salvage under commission.

Return to us later, and when the need arises. We will undertake to deal with debris fields you have claim to, and shall compensate you for whatever materials and engineering knowledge we find out there.

label.zh: 谢谢告知。我想问问其他服务……
label.en: Good to know. About your other services...

texts.zh: 谢谢您！打捞权看来在按部就班地转让；回收工作进展顺利。我们将很快联系您。
texts.en: Thank you. The transfer of salvage rights looks to be in order; the claim is good. We'll be in touch soon.

texts.zh: 噢！我很抱歉这么说，你的这堆破烂玩意好像在我们的谈话期间已经劣化的不像样子了。即使是我们也缺乏足够的技能将已经坏了这么久的残骸复原。啊呀，这是我们的老对手，熵，在趁势反击呢！
texts.en: Oh! I'm sorry to say, it looks as though those debris fields of yours have deteriorated over the course of our conversation. Even we lack the skills to recover a wreck which has been left that long. Alas, our old foe entropy strikes again!

texts.zh:
这将是我们的荣幸！清闲的[salvager_enclave_country.species.GetHandNamePlural]头脑灵活，这对我们来说意义非凡！我们将非常乐意伸出援手并与我们的老顾客分享一些实用的技巧，毕竟我们的生意可是受您照顾有加。

我们也会感谢您用于支持我们简陋的恒星基地的任何捐赠！老旧的船体可以多次改造，不过有时候，崭新熔炼的舱壁的可靠性无可匹敌。
texts.en:
It would be our pleasure! Idle [salvager_enclave_country.species.GetHandNamePlural] make curious minds, and that counts double for us! We are most happy to lend aid and share handy tips with our regular customers - so long as our modest expenses are covered.

We would also appreciate any donation you can make to help shore up our humble starbase! Old hulls can be repurposed many times over, but sometimes there's just no beating the reliability of a freshly-smelted bulkhead.

label.zh: 谢谢告知。我想问问其他服务……
label.en: Good to know. About your other services...

texts.zh:
你好，朋友！我们多年以来的合作研究一直进行得不错。我听说的是，我们的几位工程师采纳了一些来自你方的建议，同时你也采纳了一些我们得建议！

然而，当初达成的合约时间已经到期了，我们也希望让这些思维活跃的学徒们重新回到我们家里面做些事情……也就是说，除非你愿意再多给我们一点补偿，让他们再留一阵子？
texts.en:
Hello, friends! Our years of collaborative study have really whisked by. The way I hear it, a few of our engineers have picked up a few tips from you, as well as you from us!

However, the agreed upon time has now elapsed and we could use those keen-minded apprentices of ours back at home... That is, unless you're willing to compensate us for a while longer?

texts.zh: 作为我们长期客源的一员，我们自然很乐意派遣一名专家来督导你的打捞工作，只需要付很少的价钱。一开工就能拖到一大串新近烧焦的残骸，这个作为欢迎仪式想必很合适。
texts.en: As one of our more regular customers, we would certainly be willing to send someone to oversee your scrapping efforts, for a small cut. It will be a welcome diversion to trawl freshly-charred wrecks.

texts.zh: 我们为自己的长期客源提供服务，会派遣一名督工协助改进你的打捞工作，只需要付很少的价钱。不幸的是，我们现在没有可供派遣的督工——他们现在简直是供不应求，恐怕我们一些其他的客户享有优先权。
texts.en: We offer our regular customers the services of an overseer who can improve your scrapping efforts, for a small cut. Unfortunately, none of our overseers are available at the moment - they are in high demand, and I'm afraid some of our other customers take priority.

label.zh: 谢谢告知。我想问问其他服务……
label.en: Good to know. About your other services...

texts.zh:
一列发自[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]的货运驳船刚刚到达，装载着一批回收的资源。

打捞人员随货附上了一封感谢信，以及一份有形的礼物——某种动态艺术品。它在我们人工重力场中运动的方式令人不安，但也相当迷人。
texts.en:
A train of cargo barges has just arrived from the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName], carrying a consignment of reclaimed resources.

The Salvagers enclosed a message expressing their thanks, as well as a tangible gift - some form of kinetic artwork. The way it moves within our artificial gravity fields is unnerving, and yet quite captivating.

texts.zh:
一列发自[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]的货运驳船刚刚到达，装载着一批回收的资源。

货运员代表打捞者们不住地表示着感谢，直到他在我们货运拖船的发动机遮罩前怔住。很遗憾，在卸货之前，我们必须强行赶走这位激情满满、充斥着好奇心的狂热人士。
texts.en:
A train of cargo barges has just arrived from the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName], carrying a consignment of reclaimed resources.

The courier was relentless in expressing thanks on behalf of the Salvagers - that is, until they became transfixed by the engine housings on our own cargo tugs. This impassioned and deeply curious enthusiast had to be forcibly removed before any unloading of cargo could commence.

texts.zh:
一列发自[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]的货运驳船刚刚到达，装载着一批回收的资源。

被货物围绕在中间的是一个蓝图的数据库，尽管画得很急，但是每一个细节都很到位。看上去这份作品的作者，要么对于自己的发现十分兴奋，要么就是在研究某种教育形式的图表。

不管是哪一种，[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]已经将此人的研究呈递给我们使用，并送上了自己的赞美。
texts.en:
A train of cargo barges has just arrived from the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName], carrying a consignment of reclaimed resources.

Enclosed amongst the cargo is a database of blueprints, hastily-drawn yet quite thorough in their detail. It appears to be the work of someone who was either very excited by their find, or else was studying the schematics as some form of education.

Either way, the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName] has presented their studies for our use, with their compliments.

texts.zh:
一列发自[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]的货运驳船刚刚到达，装载着一批回收的资源。

货运员看上去很紧张；看得出来此人巴不得去跑其他的差事。这个鬼灵精怪的[salvager_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName]看上去急着要把给我们的食物供给品一股脑弄走。确实，这些送到手上的食物包装非常精美——几乎就像是在某些地方制造出来的替代品一样。
texts.en:
A train of cargo barges has just arrived from the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName], carrying a consignment of reclaimed resources.

The courier appeared quite nervous; visibly keen to resume some other errand. This skittish [salvager_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName] seemed in a particular hurry to divest the food supplies we have been owed. Indeed, these morsels come to us surprisingly well-packaged - almost as though a substitution has been made somewhere...

texts.zh:
一列发自[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]的货运驳船刚刚到达，装载着一批回收的资源。

货运员看上去很紧张；看得出来此人巴不得去跑其他的差事。这个鬼灵精怪的[salvager_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName]很谦恭地将那些本次打捞路途上收获的各类蓝图交到我们手上。然而，在运送食物供给品的时候，场面出现了明显的匆忙。

确实，尽管未经证实，有人看见类似长相的太空生物最近出现在了[salvager_enclave_system.GetName]星系内……
texts.en:
A train of cargo barges has just arrived from the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName], carrying a consignment of reclaimed resources.

The courier appeared quite nervous; visibly keen to resume some other errand. This skittish [salvager_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName] was courteous enough in handing over various blueprints they say came their way during the course of this salvage. There was, however, some apparent urgency behind their delivery of food supplies.

Indeed, there have been unconfirmed sightings of familiar-looking, spaceborne creatures in the [salvager_enclave_system.GetName] system of late...

texts.zh:
一艘发自从[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]的快递驳船已经满载各种蓝图和一小批资源抵达！所有这些都是从残骸中打捞回收的。

这艘驳船的领航员除了对我们的惠顾表示礼貌的感谢外很少说话。交接现场的气氛十分严肃。
texts.en:
A courier barge has arrived from the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName], carrying various blueprints and a small consignment of resources. All were reclaimed from debris salvage.

The pilot of this barge spoke little, other than to express polite thanks for our custom. The handover was treated with a great deal of solemnity.

label.zh: 呼叫他们！只要他们想要残骸，我们要多少给多少。
label.en: Hail them! We have more debris they could handle.

texts.zh:
啊哈！一位来访者。欢迎欢迎。

我们是[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]。在这个自虚空诞生的舱室里，我们的女巫集会谈论着凡人所费解的力量。我们思索着潜藏梦境中的秘密、探寻着原始灵能的贮藏地、凝视着驱动整个文明的无形齿轮……虚境对于聆听者，揭示良多。

此时此刻，我聆听于你。什么风把你吹来了？你已知否？
texts.en:
Ah! A visitor. Welcome.

We are the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]. Within this void-borne hull, our coven communes with forces incomprehensible to most mortal minds. We contemplate the secrets that lie hidden in dreams, reservoirs of untapped potential, the unseen gears driving whole civilizations... The Shroud reveals much to those who would listen.

At this moment, I listen to you. What brings you to us? Do you yet know?

texts.zh:
啊哈，是不可知世界的旅伴！我们[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]欢迎你并视你为朋友。

请原谅这种低劣的沟通方式。我们所践行的强烈的灵能祷告，恐怕只能基于可畏的心灵感应屏障和通路而施行。因此，我们只能从物质世界中接收思想之一瞥。

所以我不禁要问：是什么风把你吹来的?
texts.en:
Ah, fellow sojourners of the unknowable! We, the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] welcome you and name you friends.

Please forgive this inferior means of communication. The intense, psionic devotions we practise may only be conducted from behind fearsome telepathic barriers and conduits. Thus, we may only receive glimpses of thought from the corporeal realm.

So it is that I must ask: what brings you to us?

texts.zh: 欢迎回来，来访者。我们等候多时。
texts.en: Welcome back, visitor. We have been waiting.

texts.zh: 许多文明都讲述着同样的故事，在过于幽深的矿洞里潜伏着黑暗的存在。那么来访者，请问你是否好奇过，在我们层层的现实之下隐藏着什么?
texts.en: So many civilizations tell the same kind of story, of dark things lurking in mines dug too deep. Tell me, visitor: have you ever wondered what lurks beneath the stratified layers of our reality?

texts.zh:
我们都知道一句谚语:
“被风吹进来的东西终将被雨冲出去。”
对于许多居住在短命行星上的居民来说，算是慰藉之辞……

在被我们称为虚境的世界里，可没有这样的天气。
texts.en:
There is a saying known to us:
"What is blown in by the wind will be washed out by the rain."
Comforting words for many a short-lived planet-dweller...

The realm we call the Shroud knows no such weather.

texts.zh: 那么，我们的旅伴回来了！很高兴再次看到你。我们等候多时。
texts.en: So, the sojourners return! It is pleasant to see you again. We have been waiting.

texts.zh:
在我们[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]坚持的所有信条中，少有比这一条更坚定的：即使地位崇高如我们一般，也肯定能在星海中找到同伴。

那么，我飞升了的朋友：我们能为彼此做些什么？
texts.en:
Of all the tenets we hold to in the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName], few are held more dearly than this: even those as elevated as ourselves can be sure of finding our fellows in the galaxy.

So, fellow ascendent one: how may we serve each other?

texts.zh: 闯入者，你的敌意就像恶臭的瘴气一样笼罩着自己。我们是和平的集会，但你要知道：如果你想让我们遭受苦难，你会发现这种愚蠢的行径将以十倍奉还。我们是[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]，尽管我们看似鞭长莫及，但我们的愤怒将会毁天灭地。
texts.en: Interloper, your hostility precedes you like a foul miasma. We are a peaceful coven, but know this: if you intend to inflict harm upon us, you shall find such folly visited back upon you tenfold. We are the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName], and though our reach may appear lacking, our wrath is devastating.

texts.zh:
你可真是名过其实。

我们拒绝与畏惧虚境之人共商大计。你们对宇宙的狭隘认知终将令我们所有人固步自封。
texts.en:
Your reputation precedes you.

We shall hold no counsel with those who fear the Shroud. Your limited vision of the cosmos will chain us all to the ground.

texts.zh:
[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]的无知偏见毒害了你的思想。多么讽刺啊……

我们绝不会与和那些蠢货有染的人共商前途。
texts.en:
The ignorant prejudices of the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] have poisoned your mind. What irony...

We will hold no counsel with those who hold such ties with fools.

texts.zh:
“你唤醒了远超你理解的恐怖，它宣告了星系的末日。

我们不愿去面对这样的疯狂事物。离我们远点！”
texts.en:
"You have awoken horror far beyond your understanding, and with it have doomed this galaxy.

We are unwilling to court madness itself. Be gone from us!"

label.zh: 我们将探索虚境的灵妙。
label.en: We seek mastery of the Shroud.
What is to be our fate?

label.zh: 你们愿意从教团里派遣一位导师过来吗？
label.en: Would you be willing to send us a teacher from your order?

label.zh: 你能给我们一些有关其他帝国的见解吗？
label.en: Can you give us insight on another empire?

label.zh: 告诉我们通过虚境穿行的方法。
label.en: Tell us about travel via the Shroud.

label.zh: 你能教我们如何开采泽珞吗？
label.en: Could you teach us how to harvest Zro?

label.zh: 我们遇到了一个自称是“面纱旅人”的人……
label.en: We met someone claiming to be a Veilfarer...

texts.zh:
啊哈，一个重要的问题——和前人所问相比，深刻程度可谓不相上下。这么一个问题有不菲的价格，不过我们可以回答。

然而，要知道：虚境允许我们感知尚未发生的事件，而这些知识将帮助指导你们的道路。但任何单一的事件都不足以撼动星系的运转。

如果你有意达成这笔交易，那么相比于拓展抱负，你应该去做更充分的准备。但是，哦，哪怕是对顷刻将至之事的最细微一瞥，都可能建立起什么样的宏伟计划啊……
texts.en:
Ah, a momentous query - no less poignant for being asked by so many before you. Such a question carries a heavy price, but we can provide answers.

Know this, however: the Shroud allows us to perceive events which have not yet come to pass, and this knowledge shall help guide your course. But it is beyond the power of any one event to alter the turning of the galaxy.

If you would strike this bargain, know that your aspirations should extend no further than to be better prepared. But oh, what grand designs may be built upon even the merest glimpse at what is to come...

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

texts.zh: 虚境在战栗。它在那一刻似乎一言不发，但又诉说了一切。时间的无限之织缕从此时此刻延伸开来，进入了汇合之流。此处，这个地方，前方的道路逐渐明了。预知仪式已经开始了。
texts.en: The Shroud shivers. It speaks without voice and in all voices at once. The infinite strands of time that extend from this moment now enter into confluence. Here, in this place, the path ahead grows clear. The rite of divination has begun.

texts.zh:
星系十分黑暗，危险无处不在。为了点亮朝圣者的路途，我们提供虚境信标。一旦在你的某个恒星基地上面安装这个，它的光芒可以穿透一切；哪怕是某些人称之为现实的缥缈薄暮。它延伸出来的网道可以穿过虚境，为凡间的舰船跨越巨大的时空前往遥远的距离提供了一种手段。

要谨慎地选择你的信标的位置——虚境隧道一旦生成，就不能被移除，也没有可能再召唤出另一个信标。

你要将以下的话语牢记在心：虚境隧道不是普通的道路，就算是我们也无法预测使用这种手段会有什么后果。
texts.en:
The galaxy is dark, and full of dangers. To illumine the path of wayward pilgrims we offer the Shroud Beacon. Once installed on one of your starbases, its light pierces all; even that thin veil some call reality. The Tunnel it spawns offers a bypass through the Shroud, and a means for corporeal vessels to traverse vast distances through space and time.

Choose the location of your Beacon carefully - once established, a Shroud Tunnel cannot be moved, and no secondary Beacon can call another forth.

You would do well to heed these words: a Shroud Tunnel is no ordinary road, and not even we can foretell all the consequences of such a journey.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。
我们想要一个虚境信标。
label.en: We would like a Shroud Beacon.

texts.zh: 一阵低语传达至我们的意识：虚境的道路缥缈不定，变换万千。愿这个信标点亮你前行的道路。
texts.en: A saying is known to us: the paths of the Shroud are strange and winding. May this Beacon light your way forward.

texts.zh:
自从[Root.GetName]一些流言传到我们耳朵里已经有一段时间了，我们很高兴能够与您建立联系。

为了赚取微薄的利润，我们，[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]，目前向外提供特别服务，像是什么引擎升级，拆解舰船什么的，不管你有什么需求，我们都可以满足！

为了我们一开始就受到您的青睐，我们可以送您一件小礼物来表示我们对于为客户服务的真心，您看怎么样？
texts.en:
We've been hearing rumors about the impressive [Root.GetName] for a while now, and we're pleased to make your acquaintance!

For a nominal contribution of credits, we of the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName] offer premium salvager services. From engine upgrades to scrapping fleets, whatever your needs, you can count on us!

And to ensure that we start off in your good graces, how about a small gift to show our commitment to customer service?

label.en: We thank you for the gift.

label.zh: 异种渣滓，送个小礼物本来就是你份内的事。
label.en: A gift is only to be expected, xeno.

texts.zh: 对于我们来说有句俗话：‘秘密在梦中翩翩起舞。’对于虚境来说，没有哪个堡垒是不可突破的，没有什么密码是破解不了的。通过我们的冥想，其他人坚信深藏不露的东西会乖乖呈现在我们面前。你有兴趣了解你身边的人在密谋些什么吗？去了解他们的设想，就好像那设想就是你的东西一样？如果你有所求，我们会分享自己的见解。怎么利用这些就是你自己的事了。
texts.en: A saying is known to us: 'Secrets dance in dreams.' To the Shroud, no vault is impenetrable, no code unbreakable. In our meditations, what others believe hidden is often laid bare. Would it interest you to learn what your peers are plotting? To know their designs as if they were your own? Should you wish it, we will share our insights. How you make use of them is up to you.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

texts.zh: 掌控虚境是一次长达10000次生死的旅途；哪怕是我们最天赋异禀的导师也只敢声称自己对虚境的神秘有一些片面的了解。即使如此，他们的智慧也是无价之宝。如果你有所求，我们可以排遣一名导师为你指点迷津。
texts.en: Mastery of the Shroud is a journey of 10,000 lifetimes; even our most gifted teachers can claim only partial knowledge of its mysteries. Nevertheless, their wisdom is invaluable. Should you wish it, we will dispatch one to guide your course.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

texts.zh: 学海无涯苦作舟：这便是最高级的智慧。我们会给你送去一名导师。好好学习，你必将有所收获。
texts.en: To know that there is always more to know: this is the highest wisdom. A teacher will be sent to you. Learn well, and you will surely reap the rewards.

texts.zh:
一段非常有趣的故事。你说的是“面纱旅人”，对吧？在某些方面，这个虚境确实和我们自己的很像，但是对于不了解的人来说，这些差异可能很微妙；其实它们很深刻，是一种扭曲的反射，来自一个与我们不尽相同的宇宙。

虚境的表面有很多裂痕。那些深入其奥秘的人最终可能并不会回到他们本来的宇宙。
texts.en:
A most interesting story. Veilfarer, you said? In some ways, this coven does resemble our own, but while these differences may appear subtle to the uninitiated, they are profound: a distorted reflection, from an universe not quite like our own.

The Shroud has many tears on its surface. Those who enter its mysteries may not always end up in the same universe from whence they started.

label.zh: 跨越维度的灵能旅行……令人神往。

texts.zh: 我们对泽珞特别感兴趣。我们可以教你开采和储存的方法，但前提是你同意把你的产品永久地分成给我们。
texts.en: Zro is of particular interest to us. We could teach you the ways of harvesting and storing it, but only if you agree to give us a share of your production. In perpetuity.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。
你们会拿到分成的。教教我们。
label.en: You'll get your share. Teach us.

texts.zh: 泽珞是一种奇妙而又可悲的物质，有很多用途，但绝不能轻易使用，因为它是一个上古物种最后的遗产。开采了就要好好珍惜，也别忘了回报我们。
texts.en: Zro is a wonderful yet tragic substance. It has many applications, but should never be used lightly, for it is the last legacy of a most venerable species. Harvest it, treasure it, and don't forget to pay us what you owe.
